seo.title: Ship Design Outsourcing from Vietnam | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Ship design outsourcing to Vietnam: concept, basic and detail design of fishing vessels, passenger boats and small craft, calculations and approval drawings.

fields.headline: Ship design outsourcing in Vietnam for fishing vessels, passenger boats and small craft
fields.lead: Lasan Marine Co., Ltd. is a naval architecture office in Nha Trang, Vietnam. Shipyards, owners and design firms outsource concept, basic and detail design to us, together with the calculations and drawings needed for plan approval, delivered remotely in the formats your team works with.

items.problem: My design office has more work than engineers
items.context: You need extra naval architecture capacity for a project or a busy period without hiring.
items.solution: Take on a defined package, such as a hull form, a set of calculations or a series of drawings, to your templates and drawing standards, with your engineers reviewing and signing off.

items.problem: I'm preparing to build a new vessel
items.context: You know the vessel type, mission, operating area and key constraints, but there is no complete technical design yet.
items.solution: Develop principal dimensions, hull form, general arrangement, structure and propulsion, then produce the calculations, drawings and documents within the agreed scope.

items.problem: I need to convert a vessel in service
items.context: Lengthening · Raised deckhouse · Change of service · Re-engining · New equipment
items.solution: Review the existing documents and the vessel's condition to find what the change affects, then recheck the calculations and update the drawings needed.

items.context: The design exists; you need an independent calculation or a missing item for approval.
items.solution: Hydrostatics, intact stability, resistance and power, propeller, shafting or structural calculations, delivered as a standalone report.

fields.heading: Working with us remotely
fields.content:
Communication and time zone

We work in English by email, chat and video call from Nha Trang, Vietnam (UTC+7). Our afternoon overlaps the European morning, our morning overlaps the afternoon in Australia and New Zealand, and Japan and Korea are two hours ahead. Drawings are reviewed in scheduled calls, and comments can be exchanged as marked-up PDFs.

Your standards, your templates

Send us your title blocks, layer conventions, drawing standards and report templates and we work to them, so our drawings drop straight into your package. If you have none, we use our own and agree them with you on the first drawing.

Rules and approval

We design to the rules that apply to the vessel: in Vietnam, the national technical regulations (QCVN) for fishing vessels, inland and passenger craft, which we work with on our own projects; abroad, the class rules or flag requirements named in your contract. Tell us the rules at the start and we confirm how we will work with them before quoting.

Confidentiality

We sign an NDA before you share drawings or models. Design work produced for you is delivered to you in full, and your files are used only for your project.

steps.title: Brief and documents
steps.desc: You send the requirements and any existing drawings; we sign an NDA if needed and agree the rules, templates and file formats.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: A written scope with the list of deliverables, the input data we still need and a delivery schedule.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Work in stages with a review call at each one, so changes are made early rather than at the end.

steps.title: Deliver the package
steps.desc: Calculations, drawings and documents in the agreed formats, with native files as well as PDFs.

steps.title: Support approval
steps.desc: We answer reviewers' technical comments and update the documents we prepared until they are approved.

fields.caption: Calculations · Drawings · Technical documents
fields.heading: What will you receive?
fields.body: Deliverables and file formats are agreed before work starts. Depending on the project, they include:

items.text: Drawings as native CAD files (DWG) and PDF
Calculation reports in PDF, with editable files where agreed
3D hull models in a format agreed at the start
Documents for plan approval, classification or as-built records
Written responses to reviewers' comments on our work

items.title: Which vessel types do you design?
items.content: Steel and FRP fishing vessels, fishery support vessels, passenger boats, tourist speedboats and other small craft, both newbuilds and conversions. If your vessel falls outside this range, describe it and we will tell you honestly whether it is a good fit.

items.title: Which rules and standards do you work to?
items.content: The rules that apply to the vessel and are named in the contract. Our own projects are designed and approved under Vietnamese national technical regulations (QCVN). For other class rules or flag requirements, tell us which edition applies and we confirm before quoting.

items.title: Can you work to our drawing standards and templates?
items.content: Yes. Send your title blocks, layers and report templates and we use them from the first drawing, so our work fits into your package without rework.

items.title: How do we communicate across time zones?
items.content: In English, by email, chat and scheduled video calls. We are on UTC+7, which overlaps the European morning, the afternoon in Australia and New Zealand, and most of the working day in Japan and Korea.

items.title: Who owns the drawings and calculations?
items.content: The design work produced for you is delivered to you in full, with native files, as agreed in the contract. We sign an NDA before you share drawings or models.

items.title: Can we start if we don't have complete documents?
items.content: Yes. Send the information and documents you have, or fill in our design brief. We tell you what else is needed before work begins.

items.title: What does the timeline depend on?
items.content: The vessel type, the scope of work, the state of the input data and the approval route. The delivery schedule is part of the quote, so you know each date in advance.

fields.heading: You don’t need a complete package before you get in touch
fields.description: Send the vessel type, what needs doing, the rules that apply and the documents you have. We will review them and reply with the scope, the missing inputs and a schedule.
